styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm plaster wall #F1E8DC meeting an oat linen surface #D9C7B0 with one shallow rectangular stone slab step; information screens sit on #F7F2EA plates built from sharp-corner cards; one recurring thin signal-arc line drawn in #C4623C marks every screen corner; depth comes only from the slab step and the long raking shadow, never from gradients, never from a cylindrical podium or marble

styleLock.presentationRules: one identical two-part silhouette on every screen: a near-spherical head carrying a large oval gloss-black face mask centred on the lens with one tiny indicator LED above the barrel, riding on a rounded conical matte base that is wider than the head; head rotation on its pan-tilt axis is the only articulated move; the white body is never recoloured; both parts always rest in contact with a surface; the head is never held, gripped or touched by a hand; no lens or sensor array is invented
noDrift: no rotation, pan or tilt angle figures and no degree symbols
no resolution, pixel-count, aperture or frame-rate numbers
no load capacity, weight, dimensions or size figures
no battery life, power, voltage or working-temperature range
no material grade wording such as 航空铝 or 碳纤维, no plastic grade codes
no certifications, test reports, awards or standard numbers
no brand or store wordmark, no QR code, no membership or promo badge
no hand touching or gripping the rotating head
no camera hanging from an unsecured ceiling mount
no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles
no cylindrical marble podium, no gradient background, no cut-off product edges
